label: preparing
what: Possibly a gathering or celebration in the great hall, presented to me as an eighteen-o'clock lighting inspection. The many lanterns and chests, with Freight and Innkeeper waiting there, suggest coordinated arrangements beyond a simple inspection; Baker's eighty-loaf freight order and Builder's supplies may be connected. This is not confirmed: the bread has an ordinary freight-order explanation, and I have not heard anyone disclose a celebration or link that order to the hall. Builder's involvement in the hall arrangements is clear; Baker, Freight and Innkeeper are tentative participants. I cannot identify any additional knowingly helping person: Secretary has openly scheduled an inspection at my request, and Neighbour has been investigating rumours rather than showing knowledge of a secret plan.
